instruction: Stand the yellow pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the yellow pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Choose a candidate that fits the open fingers and squeezes across the pen width
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"]:
        chosen = c
        break
if chosen is None:
    chosen = candidates[0]

res = grasp(chosen)

# Target holder position and rim height
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen needs to be placed upright into the pen holder.
# When grasped across its width with approach=[0, 0, -1], the pen lies along 'side'.
# Pitch the gripper so the pen becomes vertical (approach horizontal, or fingers pitching down).
# To make a held pen vertical, orient gripper so the pen's axis is along z (up/down).
# Since pen is along the side vector (approach x finger_axis), we can orient side along [0, 0, 1].
# For example, approach = [1, 0, 0], finger_axis = [0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, -0, 1] = [0, 0, 1].
# First carry above the holder at safe height
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)

# Orient gripper to make the pen vertical:
# approach pointing horizontally towards +x or along radial direction, finger_axis horizontal, side along z
target_z = hz + rim_h + 0.08
move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

# Lower pen into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.06)

# Release pen into holder
open_gripper()
retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")

hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]

# Carry directly above the holder at a safe height above the rim
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.12)

# Lower until contact or inside the cup rim
lower_until_contact()

# Release into the pen holder

# The yellow pen was placed horizontally across the holder rim (detected as yellow_mug, horizontal_span ~0.14m).
# We must grasp it, orient it vertically, and drop/place it upright into the holder.
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.092)

# Grasp the pen lying on the holder
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_mug")
c = min(candidates, key=lambda g: abs(g["x"] - hx) + abs(g["y"] - hy))
grasp(c)

# Lift well above the holder rim
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.18)

# Pitch the gripper so the pen is vertical
# If the pen is held horizontally across the fingers (lying along side vector),
# tilting the gripper pitch makes the pen point vertically downward.
# We rotate approach to horizontal: approach=[1, 0, 0] or [0, 1, 0]
# Check reachability with solve_ik or move_gripper
z_target = obs["table_z"] + rim_h + 0.15

# Approach horizontally so the pen held crosswise becomes vertical
approach_dir = [0, 1, 0]
finger_axis = [0, 0, 1]
ik = solve_ik(hx, hy - 0.08, z_target, approach=approach_dir, finger_axis=finger_axis)
if not ik["reachable"]:
    approach_dir = [1, 0, 0]
    finger_axis = [0, 0, 1]

move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=approach_dir, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="joint")

# Move down slightly above rim and release
move_by(dz=-0.04)
open_gripper()

retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
